behavior: Retain typed GROUP callbacks under record, aggregate-member, and retained-byte limits.
After the DXF read completes, resolve each new GROUP's name by the positional NOD ACAD_GROUP key, the unique target DICTIONARY, and its name-to-handle entries.
Reject adapter export after failed or ambiguous imported GROUP name resolution.
Pass retained GROUP records to dxfRW::writeObjects().
Reject empty or duplicate normalized names, duplicate/invalid member handles, and member 340 references without an emitted entity mapping.

Assert dictionary-derived group name, description, and member entity identity after each read.
Supply a missing member entity handle, duplicate member handles, case-folded duplicate names, and an input with an unresolved ACAD_GROUP dictionary target; require export refusal.
For each invalid export, seed the destination with a sentinel and verify refusal preserves it.
